postmortems.title: Payment gateway timeout during checkout surge

timeline.detail: Elevated checkout failure rate detected during evening order surge
Payment gateway connection pool exhausted under load; retries backing up
Connection pool resized and retry backoff tuned; checkout success rate recovered

actionItems: Raise payment gateway connection pool ceiling for peak-hour load
Add early-warning alert on retry queue depth before failures surface to buyers
lessonsLearned: Checkout capacity planning needs to account for evening peak across all three regions simultaneously

postmortems.title: Manual delivery batch delay on high-demand title

timeline.detail: Manual-delivery orders for a restocked title exceeding 15-minute SLA
Seller-side fulfillment queue backed up after a large restock batch landed at once
Queue cleared manually and seller notified to stagger future restock batches

actionItems: Add batch-size warning to seller restock upload flow
Auto-notify buyers with an updated ETA when manual delivery exceeds SLA
lessonsLearned: Large single-batch restocks should be queued incrementally rather than pushed all at once

postmortems.title: Seller API sync failure caused stale listings

timeline.detail: Stock counts on a subset of listings not matching seller-reported inventory
Seller API sync worker stalled after an unhandled schema change in one seller's feed
Sync worker restarted with defensive schema validation; affected listings re-synced

actionItems: Add schema validation to seller inventory feed ingestion before this reaches production sync
Alert on sync worker staleness after 30 minutes instead of 4 hours
lessonsLearned: Seller-side feed changes need a staging validation pass before hitting the live sync pipeline

postmortems.title: Fraud-check false positive blocked legitimate orders

timeline.detail: Reports of legitimate checkouts being auto-declined by fraud screening
Overly aggressive velocity rule flagging repeat buyers during a flash-sale window
Velocity threshold adjusted and affected orders manually cleared

actionItems: Tune fraud velocity rule to account for flash-sale order bursts specifically
Add a manual-override path for buyers with a clean order history who get auto-declined
lessonsLearned: Fraud rules tuned for normal traffic need separate thresholds during flash-sale surge periods

postmortems.title: Regional CDN latency spike (APAC)

timeline.detail: Catalog and listing page load times elevated for APAC buyers
Edge node cache invalidation storm following a catalog-wide price sync
Cache invalidation throttled and edge nodes rewarmed; latency returned to baseline

actionItems: Rate-limit cache invalidation triggers after large price sync events
Add regional latency monitoring dashboard with automatic paging above threshold
lessonsLearned: Full-catalog price syncs should stagger cache invalidation by region rather than firing simultaneously

postmortems.title: Key-generation queue backlog after restock

timeline.detail: Instant-delivery keys taking longer than usual to generate post-purchase
Key-generation worker pool undersized for a concurrent multi-seller restock push
Worker pool scaled up and backlog cleared; delivery times back under 15 seconds

actionItems: Auto-scale key-generation workers based on queue depth rather than fixed pool size
Coordinate restock timing across sellers to avoid simultaneous large pushes
lessonsLearned: Delivery pipeline capacity needs headroom for coordinated multi-seller restock events, not just single-seller spikes

postmortems.title: Seller payout batch delay

timeline.detail: Scheduled seller payout run had not completed within its normal window
Batch job stalled on a reconciliation mismatch for a small subset of sellers
Mismatched records reconciled manually and payout batch completed

actionItems: Add automatic alerting when a payout batch exceeds its expected runtime
Isolate reconciliation mismatches to a quarantine queue instead of stalling the full batch
lessonsLearned: A single seller's mismatched records shouldn't be able to block payouts for the entire batch

postmortems.title: Price-sync latency degradation

timeline.detail: Cross-region price sync latency climbing above normal range
Read replica falling behind primary during high write volume from a catalog update
Replica caught up after write throttling; price sync latency returned to baseline

actionItems: Throttle bulk catalog writes during business hours to protect replica lag
Add replica lag as a first-class metric on the internal ops dashboard
lessonsLearned: Large catalog updates need a maintenance-window path instead of running against live replicas

postmortems.title: Bulk listing upload error affected new seller batch

timeline.detail: A batch of newly uploaded listings failed to appear in search results
Bulk upload tool silently dropped rows with malformed price fields
Malformed rows corrected and re-uploaded; validation added to reject rather than silently drop

actionItems: Reject malformed bulk-upload rows with an explicit error instead of silently dropping them
Add a post-upload confirmation summary showing accepted vs. rejected listing counts
lessonsLearned: Silent data loss in bulk tooling is worse than a hard failure — sellers need visibility into what didn't import

postmortems.title: Search index rebuild lag after catalog update

timeline.detail: Newly listed and restocked items not appearing in catalog search results
Search index rebuild fell behind after a large batch of listings landed simultaneously
Index rebuild completed and incremental indexing cadence shortened

actionItems: Move from periodic full rebuilds to incremental indexing on every listing change
Add a search-freshness metric to the internal ops dashboard
lessonsLearned: Catalog and search freshness needs to be tracked as its own SLO, separate from raw uptime
